attributes.description: Every remaining form answer, keyed by the tenant's own question text.

contact_email.description: Work or personal email for the employee.

emergency_contact.description: Emergency contact name, relationship and number.

employment_basis.description: Whether the engagement is full-time, part-time or casual.

engagement_type.description: Whether the engagement is permanent, temporary or otherwise.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

family_name.description: The employee's surname as recorded on the HR record.

financial_period.description: The accounting period the record falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

given_names.description: The employee's given name(s), kept separate for cross-system name matching.

hours_worked_per_day.description: Hours worked each day in a pay period.

leave_balance.description: The running leave balance the record must show.

occurred_at.description: When the source record was submitted/modified; the event time and the retention clock start.

review.description: A performance-review outcome where the record is a review rather than an onboarding form.

start_date.description: The date the employment started; the accrual and retention start point.

superannuation_contribution.description: Contributions made for the employee in the period.

superannuation_fund.description: The nominated superannuation fund and the member identifier.

tax_identifier_declaration.description: Whether the employee's tax-file-number declaration is held with the record.

termination_date.description: The date employment ended, for a former employee.

termination_reason.description: The manner in which employment ended.

worker.description: The employee the record is about; the required subject anchor.

working_time_opt_out.description: The 48-hour opt-out agreement the employer must record for a UK worker.
